facts.fact: MP Mohamed El-Salhy submitted to Egypt's House of Representatives a 15-article draft law on electronic extortion and AI deepfakes, defining deepfakes, setting prison terms up to life, an EGP 5 million minimum fine for platforms not removing content on notice, and a 24-hour Interior Ministry unit.
facts.system: Draft law on electronic extortion and deepfakes

EGY.note: Article states no government use of AI.
Article states no AI tool in a sector system.
Article states no AI model, dataset or computing built in the country.
Disabled persons appear only as a victim category in a penalty clause; nothing on access to information or digital services.
